listingFacts:
Airbnb listing: Cozy Lakefront Cabin on a Pond in Augusta, Maine. Entire home in Augusta, Maine. 8 guests, 3 bedrooms, 6 beds, 2 baths. Photo tour shows Bedroom 1: queen bed; Bedroom 2: queen bed; Bedroom 3: 2 single beds; Living room 2: 2 single beds. Hosted by Andrey, Superhost, 1 year hosting. Listing showed 4.97 rating from 32 reviews at capture. Private waterfront on Three Cornered Pond, two fire pits, deck with grill, and kayaks in season. About 10 minutes from downtown Augusta. Pet-friendly. Full user-supplied amenities are in amenitiesGroups. Existing website: https://augusta-lake.lazy.vacations/.
Full listing, rules and safety source panels read October 19 2026: 100 feet of private waterfront on Three Cornered Pond. Three bedrooms plus a semi-private loft with two twin beds and 3-inch memory-foam toppers; eight guests maximum. Two full bathrooms with heated TOTO Washlet bidet seats, plush towels and toiletries. First-floor bedroom and bathroom; do not imply the entire property/waterfront is step-free. Airbnb-verified lit entrance path. Open living area with pond-view windows. Kitchen has granite counters and stainless appliances. Split-unit heat/AC, high-speed Wifi, standing desk and arcade game area. Upper deck with grill/patio furniture, lower patio with pond views. Two fire pits with Polywood Adirondack chairs, year-round weather permitting. Fish for bass, perch and pickerel. Dock, kayaks and paddleboard June–September ONLY; unavailable October–May and dock removed outside that window. Views and shoreline access year-round. Host travel estimates: downtown Augusta 10 minutes, Fort Western/Kennebec River 15 minutes, Augusta Civic Center 20 minutes, Portland about one hour, Acadia about two hours; do not guarantee route times. Check-in after 3 PM; checkout before 10 AM sharp; keypad/code-lock self check-in. Only registered guests; primary guest 25+ and present for entire stay. Driveway fits five vehicles; no street parking. Quiet hours 10 PM–8 AM. No parties, bachelor/bachelorette groups, events, large gatherings, commercial photography or indoor shoes. No smoking indoors or on deck/patio; penalties may apply. Occupancy/quiet-hour violations may lead to eviction and fines of $1,000 or more, per listing. Pets need prior approval; clean up after them, never leave unattended. Driveway floodlight and doorbell security cameras cover entry points. Smoke/CO alarms, first aid kit and emergency contacts. Waterfront activities at guest risk; listing says its insurance does not cover water activities. Native vegetation may contain poison ivy; closed-toe shoes advised off lawn; supervise children near vegetation and water. Shoreline, deck, stairs and walkways may be uneven, wet or icy in colder months; use handrails. Excessive cleaning charges may apply, amount unspecified. Checkout: gather towels, dispose of trash, turn things off, close/lock doors/windows, cover upper/lower outdoor furniture and grill, load/run dishwasher, restore moved furniture and lock up. Cancellation details depend on trip dates.
